items.statement: The given exact optimality solution p is 1-Lipschitz. This abstract implication is extracted verbatim from the existing private proof and is consumed by both the existing input-estimator theorem and the actual proximal-phase comparison. It carries no new mathematical-completion credit.
assumptions: E is any real inner-product normed additive group; g,p:E→E, eta>=0.

For every x,y, inner(g(x)-g(y),x-y)>=0, and for every y, p(y)+eta*g(p(y))=y. No differentiability, probability, finite dimension, existence or measurability is assumed or concluded by this abstract leaf.
